title: Inpatient Admission and Ward Bed Placement

steps.description: Verify admission recommendation order entered by treating consultant or emergency medical officer.
Counsel attender regarding room category preferences, tariff structure, and estimate of hospital stay.
Check real-time bed inventory in target ward (General Ward or ICU) and allocate available bed ID.
Collect admission initial deposit or initiate insurance pre-authorization request with TPA.
Escort patient to allocated ward bed and hand over medical chart to receiving staff nurse.

common_blockers: Zero ICU bed vacancy requiring clinical hold in emergency observation
Insurance policy inactive or mismatch between patient name on ID and insurance card
Attender refusing allocated bed category due to tariff disagreement
